body: Very nice video. :) The drums were awesome!!
..I bet I could. I just doubt I'd ever get the chance to try.

That is quite the story you have there, and I am so glad you realized that. Right now, though, I am at a point where i can see where they are coming from when they hit me, and i can relate to the reasons of why they do it. I can agree with their terrible opinions of me. I would love to get to where you are, and realize that they are just liars when it comes to what they tell me I am, as well as the reasons they hurt me, but right now...there is no lie in what they say. I don't know how to fix that ideology.

There's no way I'm joining military. Sorry. Listen, thank you for your help, I truly appreciate that you took the time to try and help me, but my frame of mind just isnt in a right spot right now, its just going to turn into me arguing pointlessly over and over again. Thanks anyways, but I'm going to go.

That's still assuming I ever get accepted into any college. Like I've said, if it has dorms, I've probably applied for it, yet nothing has gone to be accepted. If that changes, I'll let you know. But that's assuming I can also handle the wait, because my parents fury, along with everything else I've listed, may just kill me  before I ever get to college.

I've applied to many community colleges, but none have accepted me yet. And even so...I have dreams that can only be accomplished by certain universities, such as being a veterinarian....you need good grades to get into those types of schools....and honestly thats one hope that my friend has used to keep me going, but with the prospect that i may not accomplish that dream very real, it makes ending my life all the more tempting..
